Title: Nitin's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Nitin - 29 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Kavita - 59 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Sanjay - 58 years, king, father
Look: golden crown, red royal robe

Places

1. The royal court - tall pillars, a golden throne

Scene 1: The royal court - Day

[Nitin stands in the court. Kavita stands near him.]

Kavita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nitin sits down on the throne.]

Nitin: "Yes, of course."

[Nitin unrolls the royal scroll and reads it aloud.]

Nitin: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nitin drinks the poisoned wine and dies.]

Kavita (excited): "We have to be strong now."
